hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a multiplicative x2*x5 interaction, so residuals take the sign of the product x2*x5.
rationale: The four positive residuals (+0.16) all have x2*x5 > 0 (about 1.02, 1.04, 0.49, 1.18), and the six negative residuals (-0.16) all have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.24, -1.00, -1.25, -0.41, -0.54, -0.08). The sign of the product separates the groups perfectly, while x4 and x6 take mixed values in both.
